OS.name: Operating Systems
OS.note: 3 OSTEP chapters indexed with real prose. 06_Address_Spaces → development; 08_Paging → evaluation. CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 — do not publish verbatim text; publish only evidence hashes and offsets in public materials.

AIML.name: AI & Machine Learning
AIML.note: Multiple arXiv papers with full text. Development: Vaswani2017, Hu2021_LoRA. Evaluation: Dettmers2023_QLoRA, Bahdanau2014_Attention. Held-out: Devlin2018_BERT (not used for tuning). arXiv preprints — check per-paper redistribution terms.

NETS.name: Computer Networks
NETS.note: Real-time network security paper (57 chunks, Elsevier 2024) for evaluation. Tanenbaum 6e excerpts (2 chunks) for development. Elsevier paper: check publisher licensing before redistributing passages.

TOC.name: Automata Theory & Computation
TOC.note: Willard2023_Outlines.pdf is an LLM-constrained-decoding paper, NOT a classical automata theory text. Single document only → chunk split only. Use for exploratory analysis; exclude from held-out evaluation denominators.

DBMS.name: Database Management Systems
DBMS.note: Only 2 real chunks in DB (Silberschatz 3NF card + Elmasri p145). Too sparse for a multi-item evaluation pool. Can contribute 1 exploratory candidate only.

COMPILERS.name: Compilers & Programming Languages
COMPILERS.note: Only 1 chunk (Dragon Book p192 — syntax analysis). Insufficient for multi-item pool. 1 exploratory candidate.

STAT.name: Probability & Statistics
STAT.note: Pattern recognition appendix chunks too sparse (1–2 chunks). Data Science 2019 is a book index — excluded from prose extraction.

DSA.name: Data Structures & Algorithms
DSA.note: No dedicated DSA documents with indexed prose found.
